Repositories enabled for preview

Enter one exact owner/name entry per line. Text after # is a comment. HTML files are rendered only for repositories listed here.

Adding a repository means that JavaScript inside its .html files may run as soon as they are opened. This includes code written by anyone who can contribute to that repository. The code runs outside the GitHub page and cannot access your login information or GitHub DOM, but keep the list narrow.

Wildcards such as owner/* are not accepted. Exact entries prevent newly created repositories from becoming trusted without an explicit decision.
